annotations.title: Status of a roof plan PDF job (solar roof check)

description: Where a roof_report_pdf_start job is: rendering (poll again in 10 seconds), done (summary and which PDF it is), failed (with a reason code: plan_error, render_error, render_lost) or unknown (wrong or expired job_id). A tool error here means the call itself failed, not the job.
